mapper.select: select count(1) from qc_nonconformity where production_order_id = #{productionOrderId} and status != 'CLOSED'
select count(1) from wo_operation_task where production_order_id = #{productionOrderId} and force_inspect = 'Y' and status not in ('COMPLETED', 'CANCELLED')
select count(1) from mt_material_requirement where production_order_id = #{productionOrderId} and key_flag = 'Y' and kit_status not in ('KITTED', 'DELIVERED', 'PARTIAL_CONSUMED', 'CONSUMED')
select count(1) from wo_operation_task where production_order_id = #{productionOrderId} and status not in ('COMPLETED', 'CANCELLED')

select (select ifnull(sum(planned_qty),0) from wo_production_order) as planTotal, (select ifnull(sum(completed_qty),0) from wo_production_order) as completedTotal, (select ifnull(sum(qualified_qty),0) from wo_production_order) as qualifiedTotal, (select ifnull(sum(scrap_qty),0) from wo_production_order) as scrapTotal, (select count(1) from wo_production_order where status = 'EXECUTING') as executingCount, (select count(1) from wo_production_order where status = 'RELEASED') as releasedCount, (select ifnull(sum(wip_qty),0) from ex_wip) as wipQty, (select count(1) from wo_production_order where status not in ('COMPLETED','CLOSED')) as openOrderCount

select (select count(1) from qc_inspection) as inspectionCount, (select count(1) from qc_inspection where result = 'PASS') as passCount, (select count(1) from qc_inspection where result = 'FAIL') as failCount, (select count(1) from qc_nonconformity) as ncCount, (select count(1) from qc_nonconformity where status != 'CLOSED') as openNcCount, (select count(1) from qc_rework) as reworkCount, (select ifnull(sum(scrap_qty),0) from ex_production_report) as scrapQty

select (select count(1) from md_equipment) as totalCount, (select count(1) from eq_status where status = 'RUNNING') as runningCount, (select count(1) from eq_status where status = 'FAULT') as faultCount, (select count(1) from eq_status where status = 'OFFLINE') as offlineCount, (select ifnull(round(avg(oee),4),0) from eq_oee) as avgOee, (select count(1) from eq_alarm where end_time is null) as activeAlarmCount

select (select count(1) from mt_material_requirement) as requirementCount, (select count(1) from mt_material_requirement where kit_status = 'LACK') as lackCount, (select count(1) from mt_material_requirement where kit_status = 'KITTED') as kittedCount, (select ifnull(sum(consumed_qty),0) from mt_material_consumption) as consumedTotal, (select count(1) from mt_return_material) as returnCount, (select count(1) from mt_supplement_material) as supplementCount
